summary: We recommend installing commit-commands at project scope rather than relying on user-scope installs because plugins enumerated in the project settings file travel with the repo and reach every Claude Code session deterministically. The tradeoff is that contributors lose per-checkout opt-out but gain consistent commit-message shape across the dogfood ladder. The PR also adds a project-scope CLAUDE memory file at the repo root so the policy is read on session start and updates CONTRIBUTING so humans discover the slash-command workflow.

claims.statement: the commit-commands plugin from claude-plugins-official is enabled at project scope because .claude/settings.json declares enabledPlugins with commit-commands@claude-plugins-official set to true and Claude Code reads project-scope settings before user-scope settings.

citations.title: Claude Code plugins documentation describes project-scope enabledPlugins precedence

claims.caveats: Plugin source claude-plugins-official is a public Anthropic plugin marketplace; if a future contributor wants to vendor commit-commands locally that would be a follow-up ADR not a revisit of this PR.

claims.statement: CLAUDE.md documents the project-scope plugin and MCP policy because the new file at the repo root explains that every Claude Code plugin or MCP server used in this repository is version-controlled at project scope and lists currently-enabled plugins in a table.

citations.title: CLAUDE.md at repo root documents project-scope plugin and MCP policy
Claude Code memory documentation describes CLAUDE.md project-scope file precedence

claims.caveats: The CLAUDE.md references docs/plans/2026-05-21-drop-bootstrap-and-audit-otel.md for the broader linearized-dogfood discipline but that plan doc is unchanged in this PR.

claims.statement: CONTRIBUTING.md surfaces the new commit workflow to human contributors because the file is updated in this PR alongside the settings change.
claims.caveats: Confidence medium not high because the CONTRIBUTING.md change is small and discoverability depends on contributors actually reading it before committing.

open_questions: Should follow-up branches add more plugins one-per-branch with their own pair as the linearized-dogfood plan v2 envisions, or should multiple plugins be bundled when they are clearly co-located in purpose?
methodology_notes: Bootstrap pair authored against the python HeuristicVerifier shape used by the outcome-gate workflow. Branch rebased onto main before the pair was added so the diff is exactly the plugin install plus CLAUDE.md plus CONTRIBUTING.md plus this pair. Local verification against open_outcome HeuristicVerifier deferred to CI run; if the gate scores below 3.5 the report will be revised.
